info.title: stride-frfks
info.description: A command-line program for managing Stride 3D projects without the need for Game Studio.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

commands.name: testload
commands.description: Attempts to load a Stride solution and displays all log messages.

commands.name: import
commands.description: Imports a resource as an asset and saves it as a file.

options.name: --only-result
options.description: Makes the command only log the result. [default: False]

options.name: --output
options.description: The output location where the asset should be located.

options.name: --importer
options.description: The importer that should be used.

options.name: --asset-types
options.description: Asset types that are allowed to be created, separated by ','. Special values include: all, first. Default value is: first.

options.name: --force
options.description: Forces the creation of asset files, even if they already exist. [default: False]

options.name: --absolute-links
options.description: Makes paths to resource files in the assets absolute instead of relative. [default: False]

commands.name: list
commands.description: Shows a list of all assets in the project

options.name: --ignore-errors
options.description: Makes the command proceed as normal if there were errors while loading the solution file. [default: False]

options.name: --include-external
options.description: Includes assets from external packages. [default: False]

options.name: --ignore-project
options.description: Excludes non-external project packages. [default: False]

options.name: -p
options.description: Path to a project package from which to build the dependency tree.

arguments.name: SOLUTION
arguments.description: Path to the solution file or a directory containing one.
